title: Split POL-5 into demos (POL-5), post-training (POL-6) and held-out eval (POL-7)
why: POL-5 blocked: two devin builders hit the 45-min cap with no commit, and the judgment builder (session jn7c5nvs) reports that recording 200 episodes, a GR00T action-head post-train on an 8 GB GPU, and the eval over 2.5k lines of tests cannot fit one session's $3 cap. Splitting it lets each stage land, merge and gate on its own, in dependency order; the line texts are unchanged

set.title: G1 bowl-touch demonstrations recorded for GR00T N post-training

requirement.title: GR00T N action head post-trained on the G1 demonstrations
requirement.why: Released GR00T N has no action head for this G1 or kitchen; post-training on recorded G1 demonstrations supplies one without a scripted reach at eval time

acceptance.text: finetune.py post-trains the released GR00T N checkpoint on the POL-5 episodes on one 8 GB GPU with the vision-language backbone frozen, writing the checkpoint outside git

requirement.title: Post-trained GR00T N touches the bowl from a held-out start
requirement.why: The bowl touch must come from the post-trained policy's own joint actions, never from a scripted reach at eval time

acceptance.text: With only the post-trained checkpoint's joint_pos chunks driving the G1 at 50 Hz and no scripted reach in the loop, a held-out start ends in a measured palm-bowl contact
